biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend opens a new eligible Old National checking account AND, within 75 days, completes ten debit card transactions and receives direct deposits totaling at least $500. A friend who opens the account but never uses the debit card or sets up direct deposit earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must complete within 75 days of account opening: ten (10) debit card transactions (ATM withdrawals excluded) AND one (1) or more direct deposits totaling at least $500.
Referrer capped at $500 per calendar year (10 qualifying referrals).
Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after all offer requirements are completed.
Not available to any friend or family member who already has an Old National checking account or is a joint owner of an existing one.
Tax treatment not stated in the FAQ; treat as potentially reportable income.

eligibility: Old National Bank clients who enroll in the ReferLive program. Referred friends/family must be new to Old National checking (no existing checking account or joint ownership).

steps: Enroll in Old National's ReferLive program (online registration page, ReferLive mobile app, phone 1-844-213-3046, or banking center).
Refer friends and family for a new eligible Old National checking account.
Your friend opens a new eligible checking account and, within 75 days, completes ten debit card transactions (ATM excluded) and receives direct deposits totaling at least $500.
Your $50 Visa Reward Card is mailed to you 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
